description: This file is a shell script used for testing git push default behaviors, including setup of repositories, various push scenarios, and edge cases related to push.default configurations.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks that the latest commit pushed matches the expected commit for specified revisions and repository.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Runs a push command expecting success with specific push.default configuration and verifies the remote branch.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Runs a push command expecting failure with specific push.default configuration and verifies no changes were made.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push default behavior across different workflows like central and triangular, with specified branch and remote configurations.
